title: Aerobic + strides before the Bucharest flight
coachNotes:
EXECUTION: 06:40 start. 55min at 146-152bpm (hold the band, Sun ran 136), then 8x20s strides, 40s easy. Done 07:45 for the 08:00 call.
GYM: none.
FUEL: water. Light dinner before BGY (21:45 flight), no alcohol.
GARMIN: ~70-90.
STOP RULE: HRV under 50 = 40min easy, no strides.
WHY: Sun 18 ran 136bpm vs 142-152 and booked 62 vs 120; same minutes at 146-152 books ~58, strides add the rest (+5 vs old plan).
